classification.difficultyReason: Identify equal angles standing on the same chord, then subtract from a composite angle.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Four circumference vertices at left, top, right and bottom, joined as a quadrilateral with both diagonals. The 100-degree arc spans the complete right-hand angle; z labels its lower portion. Source proportions are schematic.
spec.mathematics: The angle at the right between the chords to top and left equals the given 28-degree angle at the bottom, because both stand on the chord joining left and top. The complete right-hand angle is 100 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens 50 degrees, 28 degrees, 100 degrees and the unknown z are visible; the printed answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The upper portion of the right-hand angle is $28^\circ$, since angles at the circumference standing on the same chord are equal.
$$\begin{aligned}z+28^\circ&=100^\circ\\z&=72^\circ\end{aligned}$$
